sections.heading: Business process automation for lower cost-to-serve
sections.body:
Repetitive handovers and exception queues call for process redesign, not just task automation. We discover and redesign the work, use API-first integration where suitable, and apply RPA where interfaces require it; governed AI-assisted workflows remain within defined permissions.

Baseline cycle time, exception rate and manual effort to measure process improvements and capacity released for higher-value work. [Discuss an automation opportunity](#get-in-touch).

sections.heading: Three workflows with human control
sections.description: Illustrative workflows, not delivered client cases: each has an exception route and accountable process owner.

items.title: Invoice intake to ERP posting
items.description: Receive and validate an invoice, route approval, then post to ERP. Hold mismatches and possible duplicates for finance review.

sections.note: Products are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without a Linkfields services engagement. Discovery agrees product fit, reusable accelerator content and client-specific engineering.

items.description: Discover and baseline — Map work, volumes, manual effort and exceptions. Process owners validate the scope, costs and measures before agreeing the automation backlog.
Redesign and control — Choose APIs, RPA and AI roles. Agree human approvals, least-privilege credentials, audit trails and data-handling requirements with process and security owners.
Build and assure — Implement tasks and integration; test failure, duplicate and exception paths. Client owners accept the workflow and release gates before controlled deployment.

Operate and optimise — Transfer runbooks, monitoring and change ownership. Review exceptions and net benefits against the baseline; agree support hours, escalation routes and service responsibilities with your team.

sections.heading: Measure the process, not the bot
sections.body:
Acceptance covers completed workflow tests, approval records, credential controls, audit trails and an operating runbook. The process owner confirms that manual fallback and exception queues work before release.

Track cycle time, manual effort and exception rate over an agreed period. Distinguish gross effort saved from net benefit after licences, support and exception handling; agree attribution before linking commercials to outcomes.

See [Our approach and commercial models](/company/our-approach) for delivery governance and engagement details.

sections.heading: Plan the right engagement
sections.description: Use Time & Materials for process discovery, or Fixed Price for a defined workflow with agreed acceptance. A Dedicated Team supports a sustained automation backlog; Managed Service covers agreed workflow operations. Outcome-Based terms require net-benefit measures, baselines and attribution to be agreed.

items.title: When should we use an API rather than a bot?
items.description: Prefer stable APIs when they support the required task and access controls. Use RPA where necessary for application interfaces, recognising the maintenance implications of screen or process changes.

items.title: What happens when automation cannot complete a task?
items.description: Route it to a named owner with the reason, transaction context and next action. Test retries, duplicate prevention, manual fallback and escalation before launch.

items.title: How are credentials and AI approvals controlled?
items.description: Agree least-privilege identities, credential handling, audit trails and permitted data. Define human approval points for consequential decisions and a way to stop or change automation.

items.title: How do we assess the net benefit?
items.description: Baseline the process and include transaction mix, manual effort, exceptions, licences and operating costs. Compare like-for-like periods and agree which benefits can be attributed to the change.

items.title: What should we bring to the conversation?
items.description: Share the process, systems, transaction volumes if known and current exception handling. We can agree a discovery scope and confidentiality requirements before proposing an approach.
